__broaden__.τοῦ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); masc. gen. sg., ’of him, him’ · also relative, ’whose’ · also with a noun, ’that’ (τοῦ βασιλῆος ’that king’) · also neut. gen. sg., ’of it’, after ἐκ: ’out of it’ (the chariot-board) · also neut. gen. sg. demonstrative, ’of this, that’, as the object of a verb taking the genitive (τοῦ δ’ ἐπιλήσονται ’but that they will forget’) · also neut. gen. sg. in ἐκ τοῦ, temporal: ’from that time’ · also masc. gen. sg., ’the other’, after πρό (πρὸ ὃ τοῦ ’before the other’) · also masc. gen. sg. standing for a masculine thing: ’of it, its’ (τοῦ δέκα οἶμοι ’ten bands of it’) · also masc. gen. sg., gen. of comparison: ’than he, than him’ (after ἀμείνων) · also masc. gen. sg., of separation, with ἀπέσσεσθαι: ’from it, from him’ · also neut. gen. sg. standing for a thing, of separation after ἀπάνευθε: ’away from it’ · also masc. gen. sg. in a genitive absolute, of a stream: ’it’ (τοῦ … προρέοντος ’as it flows forward’) · also masc. gen. sg. of cause: ’on his account’ (τοῦ δὴ νῦν … φέρεις χάριν ’it is on his account that you bring favour’)
__broaden__.ἄντα: ἄντα — opposite, facing; adv. · also prep. + gen., ’opposite, over against’, following its noun · also prep. + gen., placed before its noun: ’face to face with’ (ἄντα Ποσειδάωνος ’opposite Poseidon’)
__broaden__.ἄρῃ: Ἄρης — Ares, god of war; masc. dat. sg., epic Ἄρῃ (= Attic Ἄρει), with νεμεσίζῃ: ’at Ares’ · also dat. sg. for war itself: ’in battle’ (Ἄρῃ ’in war’) · also dat. sg. of the god, of the party helped: ’to Ares’ (Ἄρῃ ἐπίκουρος ’an ally to Ares’)
__broaden__.ἐπέσχε: ἐπέχω — hold back, check, restrain; aor. 3 sg. act. (strong aorist ἐπέσχον): ’checked’ · also ’cover, extend over’, of space: ’covered’ (ἑπτὰ … ἐπέσχε πέλεθρα ’covered seven plethra’)
__broaden__.ἐτέλεσσε: τελέω — complete, accomplish, bring to pass; aor. 3 sg., epic -εσσε (= Attic ἐτέλεσε) · also ’pay in full’: ’paid’ (μισθὸν … οὐκ ἐτέλεσσε ’did not pay the wage’)
__broaden__.ἔπι: ἐπί — on, upon, over; prep. + dat., placed after its relative with anastrophe (ᾧ ἔπι = ἐφ’ ᾧ ’for which’) · also ἔπι = ἔπεστι, ’is there’, verb with anastrophe (οὐ … ἔπι δέος ’there is no fear’) · also ἔπι = ἐπί placed after its noun, with anastrophe: ’at’ (πηγῇς ἔπι ’at the springs’) · also ἔπι = ἐπί + acc. placed after its noun, ’to’ (νῆας ἔπι γλαφυράς ’to the hollow ships’) · also ἔπι = ἐπί + dat. placed after its noun: ’to’ (νηυσὶν ἔπι γλαφυρῇσιν ’to the hollow ships’) · also ἔπι = ἐπί + acc. placed after its noun, ’over’ (πόντον ἔπι ’over the sea’) · also ἔπι = ἐπί as a preverb in tmesis (ὦρσεν ἔπι = ἐπῶρσεν ’roused against’) · also ἔπι = ἐπί + dat. placed after its noun, ’for’ (δώρῳ ἔπι μεγάλῳ ’for a great gift’) · also ἔπι = ἐπί + dat. placed after its noun: ’at, against’ (Τυδεΐδῃ ἔπι … τόξα τιταίνετο ’drew his bow at Tydeides’) · also ἔπι = ἐπί + dat. placed after its noun, of place: ’by, along’ (ὁδῷ ἔπι ’by the road’) · also ἔπι = ἐπί + dat. placed after its noun, of place: ’at’ (νηυσὶν ἔπι γλαφυρῇσιν ’at the hollow ships’, with ὀλέκονται) · also ἔπι = ἐπί + gen. placed after its noun: ’to’ (νήσων ἔπι ’to the islands’)
